scenarios.title: Test orders #501 and #502: the later one's connection moves first
scenarios.expectation: The earlier order gets the ring, the later one waits, one reservation exists.

scenarios.title: Older ring failed QA, two eligible rings of different dates
scenarios.expectation: The older of the two eligible rings is given.

scenarios.title: The lock holder rolls back while another connection waits
scenarios.expectation: The waiting connection looks again and serves the ring.

scenarios.title: The first order cancels
scenarios.expectation: The waiting order gets the ring without sending its size again.

scenarios.title: Twelve orders hit one ring with no forced order
A size and a cancel hit one order together
scenarios.expectation: No cancelled order holds a ring and no ring is stranded.
